messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — prep for partner QBR next Wed. Need to finalise MDF credit pooling rules for HW marketplace onboarding. Who's free to sync (quick huddle or async)?
Matt: I'm in. Can we capture current MDF balance + planned budgets in a sheet? I put a starter tab here: https://docs.redwood.example/partner-mdf (internal)
Julia: I'll own the playbook doc and rubric. Suggest we score on pipeline influence, enablement effort, and integration complexity. Keep it lightweight.
Liam: For hardware partners we also need SKU-level credits and a per-deal cap. My gut: $50k cap per onboarding for first 6 months unless partner qualifies for fast-path. :thinking_face:
Chris: Finance heads-up — need PO/commitment language + a burn model. I'll draft a sample calc so ops can see cashflow impact.
Marta: Also add GTM checklist: PR, joint webinar, marketplace listing, solution brief. Tie MDF tranche release to milestone checklist completion.
PartnersBot: Created doc 'QBR - Partner Credit Sprint' and added Ana, Julia, Matt as editors.

Matt: Starter calc (quick paste):
```
# MDF amortization per month (example)
mdf_total = 100000
months = 6
monthly_release = mdf_total / months
# expected uplift assumptions + credit utilization rates to be added in sheet
```
I'll populate the sheet with current balances and a projection tab by EOD.

Ana: Nice. Julia — can you draft the scoring rubric? base fields: score_pipeline, score_enablement, score_tech_integration. weights: 40/30/30. Keep pass/fail thresholds for fast-path.

Julia: Yup, drafting now. Question: do we want a "fast-path" for certified hardware partners who already have marketplace listings and verified SKUs? Could fast-track to 75% upfront credits.

Liam: Fast-path = yes from my side. Need legal to sign off on the upfront clause and clawback language. @Chris can finance expedite approval if legal OKs terms?

Chris: I'll loop Legal and prepare a simple MoU template. Need to see last QBR collateral for precedent — @Marta can you attach?

Marta: Attaching last quarter's collateral in the doc and the partner playbook sample. Also pinged product marketing for the PR checklist.

Ana: Action list (summary):
- Julia: rubric + playbook draft (EOD)
- Matt: MDF model + sheet with balances (EOD)
- Chris: finance/legal MoU draft (Mon)
- Liam: proposed SKU cap table + fast-path criteria (Mon)
- Marta: GTM checklist + collateral in doc (today)
Quick check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT? :thumbsup:

Julia: +1 10am works for me.
Matt: Confirmed.
Chris: On calendar.
PartnersBot: Reminder set for 2026-03-22 10:00 PT (thread: 1859128670).

Ana: :rocket: Thanks team — want this tidy before the QBR so we can present a clean tiering + MDF proposal to execs.
